question: Does training the SHIPPED detector architecture on all available CinC patients, instead of the ~6,000 it was fitted on, raise AUROC on unseen patients?
evidence_before: The shipped artifact was fitted on 5,996 patients (artifacts/detector_manifest.json).
GENESIS learning curve: +~0.02 AUROC per doubling of training patients (docs/GENESIS.md section 8).
GENESIS locked evaluation: this architecture refit on 32,268 patients scored 0.8051 on the locked set (a different, one-time measurement; not re-used here).
model: StackedEnsembleDetector, objective 'patient', roster hgb, hgb2, et, lr, xgb@utility (the shipped configuration, backend/ml/scripts/frontier.py 'stack-patient')

arms.small: each fold's model fitted on 6,000 of its training patients (uniform, seed 0)
arms.all: each fold's model fitted on all of its training patients (~26,900)

primary_endpoint: delta pooled out-of-fold AUROC (all - small); paired patient bootstrap, 1000 draws; SUCCESS iff the 95% lower bound > 0
secondary: delta detection at a 15% false-alarm budget (paired bootstrap)
rules: The locked GENESIS patients are not touched: this runs on the full cohort's cross-validation folds, and those patients are not scored as a lock.
